$comment: Define your promotion pipeline here. Each environment is a named node. 'Promotions' lists the ordered Source->Target hops (e.g. Dev->Uat->Prod). Databases can be overridden per environment when names differ across tiers. For one-to-many (one source DB -> many dest DBs on one server), set DestinationDatabaseListFile on the target environment (see Tenants example below) or pass a longer Databases array with a single source Databases entry.
$one_to_many_example: To fan out TemplateDb to every DB in destination_databases.json on SQL-TENANT-01, add: { "Source": "Template", "Target": "Tenants", "IncludeDrops": false, "AutoApply": false }
